description: Mirror a directory tree to object storage, skipping unchanged files.

features.title: Parallel checksums
features.summary: Checksums for large files are computed in parallel.
features.author: Ama Brennan

features.title: Config profiles
features.summary: A config file can hold named profiles for different environments.
features.author: Mateo Lindqvist

features.title: Resumable uploads
features.summary: Large uploads resume from the last confirmed chunk after a dropped connection.
features.author: Ines Varga

features.title: Progress bar
features.summary: Long operations show a progress bar with an estimated finish time.
features.author: Olu Petrakis

fixes.summary: Fixed duplicate log lines when verbose output was redirected.
fixes.author: Ines Varga

fixes.summary: Fixed Windows paths with trailing spaces being skipped.
fixes.author: Olu Petrakis

fixes.summary: Fixed time zone handling in the modified-since filter.
fixes.author: Tomasz Okafor

fixes.summary: Fixed a crash when a file was deleted during a scan.
fixes.author: Dario Nwosu

fixes.summary: Fixed a memory leak in the watcher on long-running sessions.
fixes.author: Ama Brennan

deprecations.summary: Reading settings from `setup.cfg` is deprecated; use the TOML config file.
The `sync_tree()` Python function is deprecated in favour of `Mirror.run()`.

breaking_changes.summary: Python 3.9 is no longer supported; tesselate-sync now requires Python 3.11 or later.

benchmark_notes: Benchmarks ran on the project's reference runner with the same test corpus for both versions.
